integrity: The infinite tail is proved analytically. Finite exhaustive computation is confined to \(n\in\{7,16,17,18\}\) and is reproducible with the included standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies four-round burnability only; it does not determine the exact burning number for \(n\ge16\). The motivating article's publisher abstract was inspected, but the full PDF was unavailable during review.
title: Four-round burning cutoff for \(H(n,5)\)
